_comment: Canonical fixture-type vocabulary and matching rules (task outline 6.2). EDIT THIS FILE to teach the pipeline new fixture names -- no extraction code changes required. Matching order: exact canonical name, then rules below sorted by priority (low first), then fuzzy fallback, then 'unknown' + flag.
_componentTypesComment: Section 6.2 / 8.5: these are component labels used inside a parent fixture's components[]. They are NEVER independent top-level fixture types and are excluded from the ordered/approved/installed reconciliation in 8.8.
_sensorTypesComment: Section 8.6: sensors ARE first-class top-level types. Accessory-grouping (8.5) must never be applied to them. 'Sensor - Unspecified' covers a contractor line that bills sensor installs without naming a tier -- per KCE, the installer's rate is the same for Basic and Advance, so tier is a BGE cost distinction only, never an install-billing one.
_skuMapComment: AUTHORITATIVE exact-SKU lookup, checked BEFORE any text rule. A distributor part number is unambiguous where its description is not -- e.g. ESPVEFT2X28... reads like a 2x2 volumetric but KCE confirms it is a 2' Strip. Source: Bob Bell Ford Inventory Reconciliation (KCE-maintained). Add a row here whenever a new SKU is confirmed; it beats every heuristic.
_rulesComment: A rule matches when every regex in 'all' matches, at least one in 'any' matches (or 'any' is empty), and none in 'none' match. Text is lowercased and whitespace-collapsed first. Lower priority wins, so primary fixtures (10) beat accessories (50) on strings like 'Exterior LED 70W Flood, Photocell w/ knuckle'.
_sizeClassComment: Section 8.6: sizeClass is DELIBERATELY coarser than canonical fixtureType -- 4' Strip and 2x4 Volumetric Kit are distinct canonical types but share sizeClass '4ft'. Sensor validation sums by THIS field, never by fixtureType. First matching rule wins.
_wattageTierComment: Section 4.1 / 8.7: categories whose piece rate depends on wattage. Used to (a) keep two-tier categories from collapsing into one rate row, and (b) decide when a contractor line's missing wattage warrants a flag. High Bay and Pole Light are tiered in the current KCE rate card even though both tiers currently price identically -- they are modeled separately because they could diverge.
_accessoryRulesComment: Section 8.5 rule table. 'parentSizeClasses' restricts which parent a photocell may attach to; an accessory whose type is absent here falls through to needs_confirmation.

Photocell.note: Always pairs with the exterior fixture on the same Line/Location (Wall Pack, Flood Light, Pole Light).

EM Battery Backup.note: Typically pairs with an interior fixture on the same Line/Location. Always raise a confirmation flag, even when the pairing looks obvious.

Lens and Wire Guard.note: Accessory with no association rule in the 8.5 table -- grouped with the fixture sharing its Line/Location, but that pairing is a guess and must be confirmed.
